subject: Evidence handoff: EastShore marketplace connector — DPIA sampling & transfer assurances
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@eastshorebank.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@eastshorebank.com
Date: 2026-08-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: DPIA excerpts & sampling plan for marketplace connector onboarding

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. As part of our vendor onboarding and upcoming internal audit, EastShore needs a compact evidence pack to complete the DPIA and Article 28/30 review for the Redwood marketplace connector (used by our payments team). Specifically we need: 

- A short DPIA summary showing high-level processing purposes and legal basis (1 page preferred)
- Excerpt of your Article 30 register showing processing activities related to the connector
- Current subprocessor snapshot for any infra, telemetry, analytics, and KMS providers (names, locations, subprocessor roles)
- Evidence of lawful data transfers (SCCs/transfer mechanism summary) and KMS region map
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (or equivalent) report or control summary
- A proposed sampling plan for on-demand logs / data traces (we will review and approve)

Could you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery date? Our target is to close the onboarding review by Aug 31 so we can go-live with the integration in September. If any of this requires a formal NDA/flash drive transfer or a separate evidence portal, let us know.

Best,
Anita Shah
Vendor Risk Manager
EastShore Bank

From: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@eastshorebank.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: DPIA excerpts & sampling plan for marketplace connector onboarding

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear list and timeline. We're able to deliver the majority of these artifacts. Quick summary of what we'll provide and timing: 

- DPIA summary (1p) — draft by EOD Aug 20
- Article 30 excerpt (CSV) — by Aug 21
- Subprocessor snapshot (xlsx) — includes infra/KMS/analytics; Aug 21
- SCCs / transfer mechanism summary & KMS region map — Aug 21
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II (control summary and redacted report) — by Aug 22
- Proposed sampling plan (logs/traces, 30-day window) — attached as a draft in our evidence packet

We'll share via a protected Google Drive folder and send a secure download link. If you prefer DocuSign for access attestation, we can include it. To confirm scope: will the review need raw request/response traces (PII redacted) or only metadata traces? That affects the sampling approach and timelines.

I'm copying Marissa (privacy ops) and Karthik (security controls) to own the artifacts — Ben will coordinate SOC2 redaction. Proposed next step: quick 30-minute sync Thurs Aug 20 at 10am PT to walk the packet. Does that work?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com, karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-08-19T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Draft: evidence packet contents for EastShore (internal)

Olga / team — following up after my review with infra and legal. Below is a concise list we'll assemble into the evidence folder. I'll upload items and mark owners.

1) ESB_DPIA_Summary_2026-08-22.pdf — 1p executive summary (Marissa)
2) Article30_excerpt_2026-08.csv — activity rows filtered to 'marketplace connector' (Karthik)
3) scc_subprocessor_snapshot.xlsx — names, roles, locations, contract dates (Karthik)
4) kms_region_map.png — KMS cluster/regional mapping and customer key residency note (Infra)
5) soc2_type2_redacted.pdf — redacted sections for customer delivery (Ben)
6) sampling_plan_logs_30d.docx — proposed fields, redaction approach, sampling rules (Marissa)
7) readme.txt — explanation of redactions, contact points, and how to request deeper traces (Marissa)

Notes: 
- We will not provide raw PII. For any raw traces we will use a secure, time-limited export and require a non-disclosure attestation.
- SCCs are standard EU Commission modules; where we rely on other transfer mechanisms we'll note substitution.
- If EastShore requires an on-site or live audit of logs, we need to convert the request to a formal audit engagement (lead time ~4 weeks).

I'll start uploading the non-sensitive artifacts tonight. Olga — can you confirm the Thurs sync and whether Anita wants raw log sampling or metadata-only?

Subject: Evidence packet: EastShore marketplace connector — delivery and next steps

Hi Anita,

Per our plan, we've uploaded a compact evidence packet to a protected Drive folder and attached the key files to this message (filenames below). The folder is shared with your domain and is accessible via the link at the end of the email. If you need a different transfer mechanism (SFTP/Ent-Lite share), say the word and we'll arrange it.

What we've provided (redacted where appropriate):
- ESB_DPIA_Summary_2026-08-22.pdf (1p DPIA summary, Marissa)
- Article30_excerpt_2026-08.csv (filtered to connector processing activities, Karthik)
- scc_subprocessor_snapshot.xlsx (current subprocessors and roles)
- kms_region_map.png (map of KMS regions and customer key residency note)
- soc2_type2_redacted.pdf (control summary + redacted report, Ben)
- sampling_plan_logs_30d.docx (proposed sampling fields + redaction rules)
- readme.txt (explanation of redactions and how to request additional evidence)

A few important operational notes: 
- We redact PII; if you need raw traces for a formal audit we require an NDA addendum + audit request form (details in readme.txt).
- SCCs are included in the subprocessor snapshot row and referenced in the readme. We will provide signed SCCs during contracting if you need originals.
- KMS is resident in us-west and europe-west clusters; keys are customer-isolated when customers opt for Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK). Details in kms_region_map.png.

Access link (protected): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c_example_shared_evidence
HubSpot record: HS-3489123

Next steps requested from EastShore: 
1) Confirm whether metadata-only sampling is sufficient or if you require redacted raw traces (and the justification) — this will determine the audit channel.
2) Please confirm review window (we suggested Aug 27) so we can prioritize any follow-up exports.

If it's helpful, we can schedule a short walkthrough of the packet tomorrow (Aug 23) with Marissa and Karthik.

Thanks and standing by,

Olga Petrov
Privacy Program Manager
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: ESB_DPIA_Summary_2026-08-22.pdf; Article30_excerpt_2026-08.csv; scc_subprocessor_snapshot.xlsx; kms_region_map.png; soc2_type2_redacted.pdf
